SELECT quartier_lib AS quartier,
       COUNT(*) AS fiches_valides,
       SUM(CASE WHEN acompte_verse = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acomptes,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN acompte_verse = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS taux_acompte_pct
FROM reponses
WHERE statut <> 'rejected'
  AND resultat_filtre = 'valide'
GROUP BY quartier_lib
ORDER BY taux_acompte_pct DESC, fiches_valides DESC
